candidate: NVFP4 dense FFN feasibility on the unchanged deployed CUDA backend
control: The actual quantization types and matrix shapes of the 64 target layers' FFN weights
scope: Synthetic operator screen before model conversion. Exclude the appended MTP layer, attention and output weights.

correctness.reference: Existing CPU-reference NVFP4 backend cases, including native activation precision where available
correctness.require: All selected supported cases execute and pass; retain native FP4 activation tolerance, which is not a model-quality allowance.

performance.weights: Number of target FFN tensors of each original type and shape

promotion: Only a passing operator screen may justify original-weight provenance checks, one separate conversion, precision and task-quality validation, and matched full-model timing.
stop: Do not select a favorable type subset, change activation precision or retune shapes after a failed screen.
attribution: NVFP4 kernels are existing upstream work; this is local format/applicability evidence, not an original kernel gain.
